powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:USERPROFILE\.ai-workspace\scripts\run-agent-python.ps1" -c "
import json, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

# vscdb chat-related keys (keys only, no values)
db = Path('C:/Users/win/AppData/Roaming/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb')
conn = sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro', uri=True)
cur = conn.cursor()
patterns = ('chat', 'composer', 'conversation', 'aichat', 'cursorChat', 'bubble', 'agent')
for table in ('ItemTable', 'cursorDiskKV'):
    try:
        cur.execute(f'SELECT key FROM {table}')
        keys = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
        matched = [k for k in keys if any(p.lower() in k.lower() for p in patterns)]
        print(f'{table}: total_keys={len(keys)} matched={len(matched)}')
        for k in sorted(matched)[:40]:
            print(f'  KEY: {k[:200]}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{table}: err {e}')
conn.close()

print('--- workspaceStorage mapping ---')
ws = Path('C:/Users/win/AppData/Roaming/Cursor/User/workspaceStorage')
for d in sorted(ws.iterdir()):
    if not d.is_dir():
        continue
    wj = d / 'workspace.json'
    if wj.exists():
        data = json.loads(wj.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        folder = data.get('folder') or data.get('configuration', {}).get('folder')
        sz = sum(f.stat().st_size for f in d.rglob('*') if f.is_file())
        print(f'{d.name[:12]}... | {sz//1024}KB | {folder}')
"
